m < MR; ++m)\n        for (int n = 0; n < NR; ++n) acc[m][n] = C[(i0 + m) * N + j0 + n];\n    for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {\n        const double* b = B + k * N + j0;\n        for (int m = 0; m < MR; ++m) {\n            const double a = A[(i0 + m) * N + k];\n            for (int n = 0; n < NR; ++n) acc[m][n] = std::fma(a, b[n], acc[m][n]);\n        }\n    }\n    for (int m = 0; m < MR; ++m)\n        for (int n = 0; i < i1; ++i)\n        for (size_t k = k0; k < k1; ++k) {\n            const double a = A[i * N + k];\n            for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) C[i * N + j] = std::fma(a, B[k * N + j], C[i * N + j]);\n        }\n}\n// C[i0:i1, j0:j1] = A[i0:i1, :] * B[:, j0:j1]\nstatic void cpuTile(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B, double* __restrict__ C,\n                    size_t N, size_t i0, size_t i1, size_t j0, size_t j1) {\n    for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)\n        for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) C[i * N + j] = 0.0;\n    const size_t iFull = i0 + ((i1 - i0) / MR) * MR;\n    const size_t jFull = j0 + ((j1 - j0) / NR) * NR;\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; k0 < N; k0 += KBLK) {\n        const size_t k1 = (k0 + KBLK < N) ? k0 + KBLK : N;\n        for (size_t i = i0; i < iFull; i += MR)\n            for (size_t j = j0; j < jFull; j += NR) microKernel(A, B, C, N, i, j, k0, k1);\n        if (jFull < j1) scalarBlock(A, B, C, N, i0, iFull, jFull, j1, k0, k1);\n        if (iFull < i1) scalarBlock(A, B, C, N, iFull, i1, j0, j1, k0, k1);\n    }\n}\nint main(int argc,char**argv){ size_t N=atoi(argv[1]); size_t TR=atoi(argv[2]), TC=atoi(argv[3]); int T=omp_get_max_threads();\n std::vector<double> A(N*N),B(N*N),C(N*N);\n for(size_t i=0;i<N*N;++i){A[i]=(i%7)*0.1;B[i]=(i%5)*0.3;}\n size_t rows = N; \n auto t0=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n size_t nti=(rows+TR-1)/TR, ntj=(N+TC-1)/TC;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(dynamic)\n for(size_t t=0;t<nti*ntj;++t){ size_t ti=t/ntj, tj=t%ntj;   // tile rows / cols\n// Ap: MR rows x kc, row stride kc ; Bp: kc x TC, row stride TC ; acc over kc; C stride N\nstatic inline void microKernel(const double* __restrict__ Ap, const double* __restrict__ Bp,\n                               double* __restrict__ C, const size_t N, const size_t kc) {\n    __m256d acc[MR][NR / 4];\n    for (int m = 0; i < rows; ++i)\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < kc; ++k) {\n            const double a = Ap[i * kc + k];\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < cols; ++j) C[i * N + j] = std::fma(a, Bp[k * TC + j], C[i * N + j]);\n        }\n}\nstruct Packs { std::vector<double> Ap, Bp; Packs(): Ap(TR*KBLK), Bp(KBLK*TC) {} };\n// C[i0:i1, j0:j1] = A[i0:i1, :] * B[:, j0:j1]\nstatic void cpuTile(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B, double* __restrict__ C,\n                    size_t N, size_t i0, size_t i1, size_t j0, size_t j1, Packs& p) {\n    const size_t rows = i1 - i0, cols = j1 - j0;\n    for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)\n        for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) C[i * N + j] = 0.0;\n    const size_t rFull = (rows / MR) * MR, cFull = (cols / NR) * NR;\n    double* Ap = p.Ap.data(); double* Bp = p.Bp.data();\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; j < cols; ++j) dst[j] = src[j];\n        }\n        for (size_t r = 0; r < rFull; r += MR)\n            for (size_t c = 0; c < cFull; c += NR)\n                microKernel(Ap + r * kc, Bp + c, C + (i0 + r) * N + j0 + c, N, kc);\n        if (cFull < cols) scalarBlock(Ap, Bp + cFull, C + i0 * N + j0 + cFull, N, kc, rFull, cols - cFull);\n        if (rFull < rows) scalarBlock(Ap + rFull * kc, Bp, C + (i0 + rFull) * N + j0, N, kc, rows - rFull, cols);\n    }\n}\nint main(int argc,char**argv){ size_t N=atoi(argv[1]); int T=omp_get_max_threads();\n std::vector<double> A(N*N),B(N*N),C(N*N);\n for(size_t i=0;i<N*N;++i){A[i]=(i%7)*0.1;B[i]=(i%5)*0.3;}\n size_t rows = N; \n auto t0=std::chrono::steady_clock::now();\n size_t nti=(rows+TR-1)/TR, ntj=(N+TC-1)/TC;\n#pragma omp parallel\n { Packs p;\n#pragma omp for schedule(dynamic)\n for(size_t t=0;t<nti*ntj;++t){ size_t ti=t/ntj, tj=t%ntj; The accumulation order over k is\n// sequential, matching the GPU kernel bit for bit.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\nnamespace cpu {\n\nconstexpr size_t MR = 6; n < NR; ++n) C[m * N + n] = acc[m][n];\n#endif\n}\n\n// Generic edge kernel for the parts of a tile not covered by whole MR x NR blocks.\nstatic void edgeKernel(const double* __restrict__ Ap, const double* __restrict__ Bp,\n                       double* __restrict__ C, const size_t N, const size_t kc, const size_t rows,\n                       const size_t cols) {\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < rows; ++i) {\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < kc; ++k) {\n            const double a = Ap[i * kc + k];\n            const double* b = Bp + k * TILE_COLS;\n            double* c = C + i * N;\n            for (size_t j = 0; j < cols; ++j) c[j] = std::fma(a, b[j], c[j]);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nstatic void multiplyTile(const double* __restrict__ A, const double* __restrict__ B,\n                         double* __restrict__ C, const size_t N, const size_t i0, const size_t i1,\n                         const size_t j0, const size_t j1, Packs& p) {\n    const size_t rows = i1 - i0;\n    const size_t cols = j1 - j0;\n    for (size_t i = i0; i < i1; ++i)\n        for (size_t j = j0; j < j1; ++j) C[i * N + j] = 0.0;\n\n    const size_t rFull = (rows / MR) * MR;\n    const size_t cFull = (cols / NR) * NR;\n    double* Ap = p.Ap.data();\n    double* Bp = p.Bp.data();\n\n    for (size_t k0 = 0; 1) / numColTiles_;\n        if (gpuLow_ <= cpuBoundary) return false;\n        const size_t avail = gpuLow_ - cpuBoundary;\n        // Take a shrinking fraction of what is left so the GPU's final block\n        // (its load-imbalance tail) stays small.\n        size_t take = (avail + 7) / 8;\n        take = std::min(take, maxGpuChunks_);\n        take = std::max<size_t>(take, 1);\n        gpuLow_ -= take;\n        first = gpuLow_;\n        count = take;\n        return true;\n    }\n\nprivate:\n    std::mutex mutex_;\n    const size_t numChunks_;\n    const size_t numColTiles_;\n    size_t cpuNextTile_ = 0;\n    size_t gpuLow_;\n    const size_t maxGpuChunks_;\n};\n\nstatic void hybridMultiply(const double* A, const double* B, double* C, const size_t N,\n                           const size_t numRows, GpuContext& ctx) {\n    if (numRows == 0) return;\n\n    WorkPool pool(numRows, N, ctx.maxRows / cpu::TILE_ROWS);\n\n#pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        if (omp_get_thread_num() == 0) {\n            // GPU driver: streams row blocks through the device, double buffered.\n            int s = 0;\n            bool busy[GpuContext::NUM_STREAMS] = {false, false};\n            size_t first = 0, count = 0;\n            while (pool.claimGpuChunks(first, count)) {\n                const size_t r0 = first * cpu::TILE_ROWS;\n                const size_t r1 = std::min(numRows, (first + count) * cpu::TILE_ROWS);\n                const size_t rows = r1 - r0;\n\n                cudaStream_t st = ctx.streams[s];\n                if (busy[s]) CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(st));\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(ctx.dA[s], A + r0 * N, rows * N * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyHostToDevice, st));\n                const dim3 block(gpu::TX, gpu::TY);\n                const dim3 grid(static_cast<unsigned>((N + gpu::BN - 1) / gpu::BN),\n                                static_cast<unsigned>((rows + gpu::BM - 1) / gpu::BM));\n                gpu::matmulKernel<<<grid, block, 0, st>>>(ctx.dA[s], ctx.dB, ctx.dC[s], N, rows);\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaGetLastError());\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpyAsync(C + r0 * N, ctx.dC[s], rows * N * sizeof(double),\n                                           cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost, st));\n                busy[s] = true;\n                s = (s + 1) % GpuContext::NUM_STREAMS;\n            }\n            for (int i = 0; i < GpuContext::NUM_STREAMS; ++i) {\n                if (busy[i]) CUDA_CHECK(cudaStreamSynchronize(ctx.streams[i]));\n            }\n        }\n\n        // CPU workers (the GPU driver joins once the GPU has no work left).\n        cpu::Packs packs;\n        size_t chunk = 0, colTile = 0;\n        while (pool.claimCpuTile(chunk, colTile)) {\n            const size_t i0 = chunk * cpu::TILE_ROWS;\n            const size_t i1 = std::min(numRows, i0 + cpu::TILE_ROWS);\n            const size_t j0 = colTile * cpu::TILE_COLS;\n            const size_t j1 = std::min(N, j0 + cpu::TILE_COLS);\n            cpu::multiplyTile(A, B, C, N, i0, i1, j0, j1, packs);\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n'''\nsrc = src[:start] + new_cpu + src[end:]\n\n# 3. {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011CgNE2k7JLjszcW9Tao3es","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"The matmul benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA program. Only the two existing files changed, the executable is still `matmul`, and no new dependencies were added.\n\n**How the work is split**\n\n- **MPI** distributes contiguous row blocks of A and C across ranks. Every rank regenerates B locally from the deterministic formula, so nothing is communicated before the multiply. Timing is the max over ranks after a barrier, and C is gathered to rank 0 only when `-r` or `-v` is given.\n- **CUDA** binds each rank to a GPU by node-local rank. B stays resident on the device, and row blocks of A stream through a 64×64 register-tiled FP64 kernel on two streams with pinned host buffers.\n- **OpenMP** threads compute 240×128 tiles of C with a GotoBLAS-style packed 6×8 FMA micro-kernel. The GPU claims shrinking row blocks from the top of the local range, and CPU threads claim tiles from the bottom, so the split adapts to their relative speed without tuning.\n\n**Correctness.** All paths accumulate over k in the original sequential order with fused multiply-adds, so CPU and GPU results are bit-identical and the output hash is the same for 1, 3, and 4 ranks at every tested size, including odd sizes like 7, 333, and 1000. Validation passes everywhere. One caveat: the serial original's hash varies by size with how GCC chooses to contract into FMA, so bit-exact agreement with it is not well defined. The Kahan sums agree to all 17 printed digits and all samples are within validation tolerance.\n\n**Performance** on this box (4× RTX 3090, 2× EPYC 7763), 4 ranks with 64 threads each under mpirun's default binding:\n\n| N | GPU only | Hybrid |\n|---|---|---|\n| 4096 | 1936 GFLOPS | 2329 GFLOPS |\n| 8192 | 2235 GFLOPS | 3913 GFLOPS |\n| 16384 | 2341 GFLOPS | 4416 GFLOPS |\n\nThe original serial code runs at roughly 1 to 2 GFLOPS. Scaling from 1 to 2 to 4 ranks at N=8192 goes 1451 → 2365 → 3913 GFLOPS.\n\n**Build notes.** The CMake file now enables the CUDA language, compiles `matmul.cpp` as CUDA, forwards host flags through nvcc, and links MPI and OpenMP via their found variables rather than imported targets, since nvcc rejects their raw flags. The local nvcc 12.0 cannot compile `immintrin.h` with GCC 12+, so the CPU kernel uses GCC vector extensions instead of intrinsics. I saved that finding to memory.\n\n**Running.** Use one rank per GPU and let mpirun bind ranks to sockets, for example `OMP_NUM_THREADS=64 mpirun -np 4 ./matmul -n 8192 -v`. Setting `OMP_PLACES=cores` with `--bind-to none` oversubscribes the first cores across ranks and roughly halves throughput."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":32,"cache_creation_input_tokens":534,"cache_read_input_tokens":93401,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":534},"output_tokens":818,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"global","speed":"standard"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"2c6c04de-86f9-4a5f-9030-063b3fb5189c","uuid":"f40107ed-7369-419c-afe0-c1f9be006cea","timestamp":"2026-10-25T03:13:28.192Z","request_id":"req_011CgNE2jpgJMZ9cx74Nga1X"}

Scaling from 1 to 2 to 4 ranks at N=8192 goes 1451 → 2365 → 3913 GFLOPS.\n\n**Build notes.** The CMake file now enables the CUDA language, compiles `matmul.cpp` as CUDA, forwards host flags through nvcc, and links MPI and OpenMP via their found variables rather than imported targets, since nvcc rejects their raw flags. The local nvcc 12.0 cannot compile `immintrin.h` with GCC 12+, so the CPU kernel uses GCC vector extensions instead of intrinsics. I saved that finding to memory.\n\n**Running.** Use one rank per GPU and let mpirun bind ranks to sockets, for example `OMP_NUM_THREADS=64 mpirun -np 4 ./matmul -n 8192 -v`. Setting `OMP_PLACES=cores` with `--bind-to none` oversubscribes the first cores across ranks and roughly halves throughput.","ttft_ms":1228,"type":"result","duration_ms":1430369,"uuid":"7b4859bb-ba04-47e8-bbbf-e4177d51968d","ttft_stream_ms":1121,"time_to_request_ms":142,"first_content_frame_ms":1122,"queued_turn_count":0,"result_index":0}
